visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair wearing a blue checkered shirt sits behind a silver laptop on a white desk. The laptop has several stickers, including a red 'STOP' sign and a cartoon bear. A cartoon girl avatar with black hair and a white outline is fixed in the bottom left corner. The man gestures with his hands as he speaks, looking directly at the camera in a brightly lit room with a neutral wall. (2) A close-up shot transitions to a dark-skinned hand holding a white smartphone. The thumb is shown scrolling through a vertical video interface. (3) The scene cuts back to the man in the checkered shirt at his desk. He uses expansive hand gestures. Graphical logos for TikTok, Snapchat, and Vine appear as overlays floating around him. (4) A cinematic transition shows a silhouette of a person playing a guitar against a vibrant orange and purple sunset sky. Text overlays appear at the bottom explaining platform features. (5) Back in the studio setting, the man continues his explanation. He moves his hands to simulate the merging of the TikTok and Musical.ly logos, which appear as animated graphics. (6) The man leans forward, gesturing towards the camera with both hands open. Text regarding an internship opportunity and a request to comment 'Short Video' appears at the bottom. He looks up and away as if thinking during the final recruitment pitch.
